children.name: Zanonia indica L.
children.description: Note: Although Zanonia dates from 1753, the account of this species (in Sp. Pl. 2: 1028) omitted any specific epithet, so Z. indica dates from 1759. Keraudren-Aymonin (in Aubreville & Leroy, Fl. Cambodge Laos Viet-Nam 15: 18. 1975) indicated all three of the cited Rheede plates (t. 47 - 49) as type. This choice was restricted to t. 49 by Chakravarty, pre-dating that of Jeffrey (in Regnum Veg. 127: 100. 1993) who restricted it to t. 47.
